device.description: 14-bit 200 kSPS 8-channel SAR ADC with +/-10 V inputs, SPI/DSP serial interface, CFR configuration register and 8-word FIFO
device.note: tlc3574.pdf (SLAS262C) p.1 pinouts, p.3-4 terminal functions, p.5-6 electrical characteristics (DVDD 2.7-5.5 V, t(conv)), p.13-14 timing, p.18-19 data format, p.19-22 operation, Table 1 command set, Table 2 CFR, p.23 conversion period and modes, p.31-32 conversion clock, FIFO, power down, p.37 SPI CPOL 0 / CPHA 1

registers.name: CFR
registers.note: p.22 Table 2: configuration register, no address, written by WRITE CFR (1010b) and loaded with 800h by HARDWARE DEFAULT (1111b). D11 always 1 (otherwise performance degraded); D10 output code format; D9 sampling (0 long 44 SCLKs, 1 short 12 SCLKs); D8 conversion clock (0 internal OSC, 1 SCLK/4); D7 single-ended / pseudo-differential; D6-5 conversion mode; D4-3 sweep sequence; D2 EOC/INT pin (0 INT, 1 EOC); D1-0 FIFO trigger level. Power-on value not documented (the input data register is all zeros after power on): reset 0

commands.name: SELECT analog input channel
commands.note: p.21 Table 1: 0000b-0111b select the channel; sampling then starts after the 4th SCLK falling edge (the conversion follows the sampling period)

commands.name: WRITE CFR
commands.note: p.21 Table 1: the last 12 bits of SDI are written into CFR (also resets the FIFO); A000h after power-on enters software programmed mode

commands.name: SELECT TEST (REFP+REFM)/2
commands.note: p.21 Table 1: internal test voltage; converted like a channel (result still the 0 V code)

commands.name: FIFO READ
commands.note: p.21 Table 1: FIFO top shown on SDO (modeled as the result frame)

pages: p.1 (pinouts), p.3-4 (terminal functions), p.5-6 (supplies, t(conv)), p.13-14 (timing), p.18-19 (data format), p.19-22 (initialization, command set Table 1, CFR Table 2), p.23 (conversion period), p.31-32 (conversion clock, FIFO, power down), p.37 (SPI mode)
notModeled: analog inputs, internal/external reference, single-ended vs pseudo-differential input (CFR.INMODE); result is the 0 V code (bipolar +/-10 V: BOB 0 V = 2000h (offset), BTC 0 V = 0000h)
FS (DSP frame sync) operation: FS low at CS falling makes the FS rising edge start the cycle; FS is modeled as tied to DVDD (SPI mode)

sampling period (12 or 44 SCLKs after the command, CFR.SAMPLE) before the conversion: the conversion is timed from the 4th SCLK (command decode); conversion time = 18 (14-bit) / 13 (12-bit) conversion clocks + 15 ns; SCLK/4 value at the 10 MHz SCLK limit of DVDD 2.7 V

conversion modes 01/10/11 (repeat, sweep, repeat sweep), sweep sequences, the 8-word FIFO, FIFO trigger level and FIFO READ: modeled as one-shot mode 00 (each SELECT starts one conversion, SDO gives the previous result)
extended sampling mode (CSTART falling starts sampling, rising starts the conversion; exit after two CS/FS cycles); CSTART is modeled as a rising-edge convert start on the selected channel
hardware default mode by two cycles with SDI tied high after power on; the first conversion result after power on is invalid
INT is also cleared by FS rising and CSTART falling; EOC is valid in mode 00 only
SDO is Hi-Z after the 16th SCLK falling edge and during conversions in modes 01/10/11; output during WRITE CFR is ignored by the host
select test voltages (REFP, REFM, mid-scale) give the 0 V code here
variants: TLC3578/TLC3574: 14-bit (8 / 4 channels); TLC2578/TLC2574: 12-bit (8 / 4 channels), conversion 13 clocks + 15 ns, result in OD[15:4]. Same pinouts, command set and CFR (D11 must be 1).
